**Issue Details:**
- **URL:** https://www.koreanair.com/contents/skypass/benefits
- **Observed Behavior:** The cookie banner is successfully hidden, but scrolling is blocked because the `-has-dialog` class remains attached to the `<body>` tag (`<body class="-has-dialog">`).
